title.value: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products

date.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.  Effective Date.  This act shall take effect July 1, 2025.

pfas_definition.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.  II.(a)  A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.  II.  The department may request a certificate of compliance from a manufacturer of rugs, carpets, or aftermarket stain and water resistant treatments.

intentionally_added.provenance: II.  A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.  II.(b)  This paragraph shall not apply to the sale or resale of used products.
